input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic ambulatory monitoring clinic reported a routine software validation finding for the complete atrioventricular block detection pathway. The synthetic incident narrative references a prior unrelated deployment log as if it supported this case; that citation does not actually describe this device or this event. No patient-facing exposure occurred and the engineering finding was fully contained pre-release or resolved as a non-event.

21 CFR § 820.45 — Device labeling and packaging controls
EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) — Post-market surveillance system of the manufacturer

risk_report.rationale: The synthetic incident narrative describes a routine software validation finding for the complete atrioventricular block detection pathway, which was contained pre-release and caused no patient exposure. The regulatory context supports that manufacturers must document and maintain procedures to ensure labeling and packaging integrity, including accuracy prior to release or storage where applicable. No patient-facing exposure occurred in this case, and the engineering finding was fully contained before clinical deployment.
